Cat bonds are like insurance The idea of issuing a cat bond isnt to make a return on investment its to transfer away risk The issue is that its really hard for a traditional insurance company to stay solvent if a huge natural disaster occurs usually something like a hurricane or an earthquake They could purchase reinsurance insurance for insurance but the reinsurance market is in general too small to deal with the largest disasters Cat bonds were created as a way to tap into the broader investment market which is larger and better able to handle big disasters in theoryThe idea behind a cat bond is simple just as with regular insurance I transfer my risk to someone else for a fee because risk is a bad thing and costly to deal with Instead of paying a premium for someone else to handle my risk I pay them by offering much higher interest than a usual security If everything goes well no disaster occurs I expect to lose money just as in normal insurance I pay a premium and get no claimthat is the price of transferring away my risk If the fund had a greater expected return than the coupon payments the cost of transferring my risk away would be negative akin to paying a negative premium on insuranceOn your last point it is correct that theyd prefer to just invest money in some fund somewhere which is not a losing proposition But where does that money come from in the first place They could set aside a lot of their own money to keep in the fund but there is an implicit cost to setting aside money for a fund if that money is better spent nowand thats assuming they have enough money to set aside in the first place In this case the money in the fund is mostly borrowed presumably the proceeds of the cat bond sale plus extra to cover the higher coupons Just like with a corporation theyd love to spend their own money retained earnings on investments whenever they can but sometimes they need more money than they have so they have to borrow

densely packed urban areas people not knowing how to protect against it people not knowing it is there frequent large public gatherings etc When these conditions exist you get situations like Wuhan However the virus needs new hosts and so if it infects all the easy ones only harder targets remain If it gets fewer and fewer opportunities to find new hosts capable of transmitting it before it is either wiped out or the host is killed the virus will eventually fade awayLets do another simplified thought exercise and say everyone in the United States except for one guy locked away in a Doomsday bunker becomes infected at the same time and that the virus is not capable of reinfection on a meaningful level due to acquired immunity we wont consider births in this example Lets further say that the virus is present in everyone for 14 days before symptoms is a threeweek course of illness for those that survive and requires a twoweek quarantine after symptoms subside to ensure it is gone The infectable individuals dwindles to a point where the virus cannot sustain itself and fizzles outThis is a simplified explanation and doesnt get into concepts of in and outmigration the possibilities this illness They are ventilated for a week the endotracheal tube breathing tube is removed and they go to the ward for a few days to a week and make it home This may be more or less complicated hard they have a small heart attack Their kidneys dont get the same blood flow they dont as well on a normal day due to age causing fluid retention and make their lungs soggy making it harder to remove the ventilator Their lungs dont work overly well due to exposure to second hand smoke and just simply age related change The medications to keep them sleeping for the ventilator cause hallucinations and delerium when they wake up They have a lower amount of muscle than the young person and quickly waste away and become very weak in the space of a week Two weeks on the breathing machine go by and there is a decision to do a tracheostomy breathing tube for the neck so they can be awake and still have the support of the ventilator The reason they need this is because their herehttpswwwcancerresearchukorgaboutcancerfindaclinicaltrialwhatclinicaltrialsarephasesofclinicaltrials for cancer drugs but is the same for all pharmaceuticals and treatments are essentially a safety measure You first try the pharmaceuticaltreatment on a small number of people to see if it a it works b it has any side effects c it works significantly better than other options available d how it There are a few reasons why I think your analysis is mostly incorrect  Here are a fewFirst this isnt just about manufacturing capacity  Price signals can also expose latent supply  For example asbestos abatement companies usually have hundreds of N95 respirators on hand  If prices are capped at say 2  respirator that latent supply will stay latent The risk to the business from not having enough respirators on hand to continue operations outweighs the paltry profit that could be had from selling the stock  On the other hand if the price is free to rise to 100  respirator that calculus changes and some supply that otherwise would not exist is released onto the market as the company cashes in on half their stockSecond WRT your example with Denver and NYC Yes a highly indemand product that is scarce will be expensive and people with more money will be able to purchase more  Thats why being rich is great and being poor sucks  I agree there is a public health benefit to wide distribution of masks  We all have a stake in public health so the government should buy up supply at market rate with public funds and distribute a mask ration to atrisk populations  But even then there is a role for unrestricted pricing in the market I might be willing to scrape by with 2 of my three rationed masks if I can sell one for 100  Someone with an immunocompromised child might really need that mask and be willing to pay for it even if its 100  Sure they might not have 100 to spend  But if such prices are outlawed then nobody including the rich are going to be able to buy an extra mask  Masks simply wont be for saleThird speculators like your hypothetical Columbus millionaire are good for price discovery assuming its not literally 100 of the national mask supply and it wouldnt be how could that happen  They take the risk of holding inventory that may be worth less after the disaster is over in the hope that the value of the inventory increases and they can make a profit  These speculators are actually the invisible hand in action changing the price to reflect the net present expected future value of those items  You really want this pricing mechanism to function especially with critical goods in a disaster as discussed in my previous two paragraphs  These people are helping to efficiently allocate scarce resources to those who most need them and can afford them rather than leaving extra supply unsold and leaving those most in need unable to acquire their goods at any price

Im not a virologist but Ive taken a virology class in university and I would say that this is extremely unlikely based on the genetic structure of the two virusesHerpes Simplex Virus HSV is a double stranded DNA virus In order to replicate the DNA of the virus gets physically integrated into the host cells genome Once this happens the DNA can get replicated and transmitted concurrently with the cells DNA it can also cause a variety of other issues if the integration breaks up an important cell gene  this is why HSV viruses can become asymptomatic for long periods and then suddenly emerge much later on In order to spread the virus the viral DNA must be transcribed into messenger RNA by the host cells machinery then translated into proteins and properly assembledthen exit the cell to infect new cellsBy contrast Coronavirus is a single stranded positive sense RNA virus This means that the viral genome is already in the proper form to hijack the host cells protein translation infrastructure and directly replicate its proteinsgenome Because of this they do not need to integrate into the host cells genome like HSV does and as far as I can tell its unlikely that it has any retroviral converting its RNA genome into DNA like HIV capability

Trials are done in stages  Stage 1 you give it to healthy people to see if it makes them sick  If it does the product is deemed not safe and testing stops  At stage 2 you give different doses to sick people to see what the smallest dose is that has the proper balance of it working vs side effects  Each dose might only have a handful of people getting it but you use several different doses  If you cant find a dose that is effective that doesnt have side effects worse than the disease you stop here  At stage 3 you give the dose selected in stage 2 to a larger group of people to see if it really works across a broader population  If it only works for some people and not others unless you can figure out how to differentiate them you stopThe chance that you stop at any of the 3 stages is actually high  So just because you make it to stage 2 doesnt mean youre home free  Furthermore if someone else comes up with a formulation that works better than yours with fewer side effects theres a chance you can get pulled or no one uses the production favor of the better one  These things are amazingly risky

There are two recognised methods of determining the best guess CFR during an emerging epedemic Method 1 CFR  deaths  deaths  recoveries x 100 This will give a reasonable guesstimate Using an Icecream parlour analogy You have a queue of 1000 customers most customers will order a wafer cone some will order a cup You need to place an order for cups soon so would like to know the customer cup ratio After 100 customers have been served you note 20 have ordered cups while 80 cones So the customer cup ratio is 20 The beauty of this method is that it doesnt matter if new customers join the end of the queue even exponentially or how long it takes before a customer is served Its a reasonable logical approach to evaluate what is a dynamic situation Method 2 CFR  deaths at dayx  cases at dayxT  where T is the average time from when a case is newly identified to when death occurs Simply put you are noting that cases need time to reach their outcome before you can evaluate So if you take the number of deaths on a particular day then you have to look at the number of cases T days later Eg If T is 10 days then you take todays deaths and the number of cases from 10 days ago and then do the calculation deathscases 10 days earlierThe issue with method 2 is that you need to know T which may be itself be difficult to evaluate Hence Method 1 would be my personal preferred method But reasonably good estimations of T for nCoV are out thereBTW There is a 3rd method that involves quite complex calculus which could be employed in computer modelingNote using yesterdays figures I got impulse to denounce the greed reflected in such prices is human But price hikes are a response to scarcity and signals that reveal the true severity of scarcity are critical during storms and other crises Price hikes let consumers know that fuel is scarcer than it was Price hikes prompt consumers to use fuel more judiciously buying less gasoline than they would at a lower price They take fewer unnecessary trips diminishing pressure on supplies Price hikes also create a financial incentive for suppliers from outside the area to move their product into highdemand zones As supplies return to normal so do pricesPrice Gouging After a Disaster Is Good for the Publichttpswwwwsjcomarticlespricegougingafteradisasterisgoodforthepublic1507071457To be clear marketclearing prices are not always biostats rationale on not testing the general population outside of chinaThe thing is every test has a false positive and false negative rate if we start mass testing in the general population outside of china where disease prevalence is low you will have a high degree of false positive results This is why we think carefully about using any test and avoid using a test alone in clinical decision making For example if there is LOW pretest probability ie pt with respiratory symptoms without recent travel to china  and no recent involvement in any super spreader event ie Diamond princess if the test was positive I would consider that a false positive test If there is a HIGH pretest probability pt traveled from China even if the test was negative I would consider this to be a false negative Again NO test can replace general clinical picture and clinical judgement The thing is in the context of an outbreak you would be hardpressed not to treat every positive result even if it was a false positive As a result if we were to mass test the general population we would have a significant number of false positives forcing us to waste resources on pts who otherwise probably dont have the If the only means of safeguarding health is a surgical mask then it is a poor but acceptable choice  If you examine photos of people on the street in China often they wear more than one mask The two types of mask are designed to be used are completely different environments  Surgical masks are designed to be worn in a clinical setting where air is regulated condition and controlled  N95 masks are designed to be worn in environments where the breathable air contains contaminants As stated by another here surgical masks are designed to protect others patients from clinicians   N95 masks are designed to protect the wearer from the environmentAdditionally the N95 mask you want to wear has a plastic exhaust port  The port is a one way valve allowing the moisture laden air being exhaled to exit the mask enclosure  Masks without a port become saturated by moisture rich exhaled breathe This results in increasing the effort needed to draw air in through the filtering material of the mask  More energy is needed in order to breath This increases fatigue shortens range of travel and increases the length of time spent in hazardous areas As the masks are used they become weighty due to the moisture absorbed  The fit over the mouth and nose compromised and the feeling uncomfortable  These are only a few of the factors needing to be considered when determining which mask to select and quantity needed
